author: puttputt21
body:
My Minecraft username is puttputt21. The reason I was banned was for Ban Evasion. I should be unbanned because I did not ban evade at all, so I was wrongfully banned.  I was unbanned by another staff about three days ago, I waited almost two years to get unbanned that time. This is the only account that I own so it would be impossible for me to even think about ban evading. Yes, I have appealed for a ban around two years ago and as you know it took around two years for any response back from anyone. This time, I was banned on February 17th, 2016 at 1:07:02 GMT by PieZ. So I will tell the story of what happened, I went AFK for a little  bit while my friend BlackNova70 played. By the time I came back I was banned. I was really upset and asking BlackNova70 if he knew anything, he did not. So then I asked him to asked the staff why I was banned. He tried to do it as politely as he could without spamming. The next thing we knew he was banned too for the same thing, Ban Evasion. I do really believe that this ban is wrong, however, my last ban was not. I was hacking last time I got banned in July 2014, I take full responsibility for this. I did that crime and I definitely paid the time. I was just unbanned so why would I want to risk getting banned again, I did not do this crime so I do not want to pay the time. No one else in my family even plays Minecraft so how would anyone even have the same IP address? I hope you guys can get back to me. If you do believe that this ban is not false then please let me know why you think so and explain what ban evading is because then I am not getting what it even is. Thank you for your time.

-puttputt21
